title: Waiting to Bloom
summaryZh: 屬靈成長如同秋天播種，在看不見的暗處神正動工，時候到了必有收成。
lines: Planting bulbs in the fall feels almost irrational.
在秋天種植球根感覺幾乎是不理智的。
You bury something in the cold, hard soil, and then you just wait.
你把東西埋在寒冷、堅硬的土壤裡，然後你只能等待。
Months go by before you see anything.
幾個月過去了，你才看到一點動靜。
But spring always tells the truth about what was planted.
但是春天總是會說出關於種下了什麼的真相。
We see in Galatians 6:7-9 that, "A man reaps what he sows.
我們在加拉太書 6:7-9 中看到：「人種的是什麼，收的也是什麼。
Whoever sows to please their flesh from the flesh will reap destruction.
順著情慾撒種的，必從情慾收敗壞；
Whoever sows to please the Spirit from the Spirit will reap eternal life.
順著聖靈撒種的，必從聖靈收永生。
Let us not become weary in doing good.
For at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up."
若不灰心，到了時候就要收成。」
Most spiritual growth feels like fall planting.
大多數的屬靈成長感覺就像秋天的播種。
You pray and don't see change yet.
你禱告，卻還沒看到改變。
You forgive, but the burden doesn't feel any lighter.
你選擇饒恕，但重擔卻感覺沒有減輕。
You choose obedience and it looks unimpressive, maybe even like the sacrifices have set you behind.
你選擇順服，而這看起來並不顯眼，甚至可能覺得這些犧牲讓你落後了。
But the hidden work matters and roots grow in dark places.
但隱藏的工作很重要，根在黑暗的地方生長。
If you're in a season that feels buried and not blooming, don't assume that nothing is happening.
如果你正處在一個感覺被掩埋且沒有開花的季節，不要以為什麼事都沒發生。
God does some of His most beautiful and substantial work in the underground places of our souls.
神在我們靈魂深處，做了一些祂最美麗、最實質的工作。
Spring takes time, and when the flowers finally arrive, the wait was well worth it.
春天需要時間，而當花朵終於盛開時，這等待是非常值得的。
